Between November 2025 and March 2026, the Dutch security firm Eye Security pushed more than 2 million updates to computers it did not own to switch off a background updater that it said could have allowed an outsider to take over the machine.
The updater belongs to Time4Popcorn, an abandoned copy of Popcorn Time, a free app that streamed pirated films and TV over BitTorrent.
Popcorn Time was popular about a decade ago, and the original shut down in 2014, but several copies kept running under the same name. A separate, legal project that took the Popcorn Time name in early 2025 is unrelated to it.
Eye Security, which monitors client networks for threats, found the updater during a routine threat hunt: a program called Updater.exe on one client's laptop kept trying to reach a web address that was no longer registered.
The firm registered the address itself to see what would connect, and about 50 requests a second poured in. It later laid out the operation, which it named Operation IXIM, in a write-up and a talk at Hack.lu on October 22.
Over six months, those requests carried more than 3.8 million different hardware IDs. The IDs proved an unreliable way to count machines, because some Windows PCs shared one and some Macs changed theirs, so Eye revised its estimate to 2.5 to 3 million Windows computers and 250,000 to 350,000 Macs.

How to watch UFC 333: Volkanovski vs Evloev live streams, no PPV, start time, full card
Revenge or repeat in the rematch for the UFC flyweight title
Today's UFC 333 headline bout is for the Featherweight Championship as Alex Volkanovski defends his crown for the second time, against Movsar Evloev.
The Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi will host as the 38-year-old Australian faces the unbeaten Russian as rumors swirl that retirement may soon beckon for the Great.
Volk will go into the record books with a win that would be his ninth for the Featherweight Championship. The Aussie lost the strap to Ilia Topuria at UFC 298 in February 2024, but the Georgian-Spaniard's move up to lightweight gave the legendary Volkanovski a chance to reclaim gold in beating Diego Lopes in back-to-back fights. The garlanded fighter is arguably more complete than any other to step inside the Octagon, but at 38 he may be nearing the end. And, make no mistake, this is a test.
Evloev has had a long route to this first UFC title matchup, his 21st career fight after beginning his MMA career with M-1 Global in his native Russia. A solid striker, the 32-year-old has a supreme engine and frequently outlasts his opponents through his stellar conditioning – you have to go back 10 fights to July 2018 for his last stoppage, in his M-1 Global days. Such unbeaten records are rare at this level and he'll have to be taken seriously.

articles.title: Google Says Gmail and Photos Data Shared With AI Search Could Be Used for Targeted Ads
articles.summary:
Google has updated its privacy policy to spell out that using personalized artificial intelligence (AI) features in Search or Gemini could allow the company to serve targeted ads to users based on their activity on other connected Google services.
"You may choose to allow certain Google services, including services like Search or Gemini Apps, to access data from other Google services you use, such as Google Photos and Workspace apps like Gmail and Drive, in order to provide you with a more personalized experience, subject to the policies and settings of the accessing service," reads a policy update effective October 16, 2026.
"For example, Search may process some of the data that you allow Search to access to personalize content, including ads."
Google also notes in its revised policy that "We don't show you personalized ads based on your content from Drive, Gmail, or Google Photos, unless you choose to make data from these services available to other Google services that support personalized ads."
News of the policy update was first reported by Android Authority.
Personal Intelligence, unveiled by Google in Gemini in January 2026, allows users to connect other services like Gmail, Google Photos, and YouTube as a way to provide tailored answers in combination with their chat history preferences.
The feature is currently rolling out as a beta to eligible users over the age of 18 globally, except in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, the U.K., and Nigeria.

articles.title: Sam Altman advierte que la carrera por la IA podría terminar con una sola empresa con todo el poder
articles.summary:
Sam Altman, director ejecutivo de OpenAI, les dijo a sus empleados que la carrera mundial por la inteligencia artificial podría terminar con una sola empresa concentrando tanto poder económico y tecnológico que lograría bloquear el acceso a los chips de todos sus competidores, según reveló el medio The Information.
Altman expuso el planteo en una reunión interna realizada la semana del 13 de octubre. Presentó tres escenarios posibles para el final de la carrera por la inteligencia artificial más avanzada y calificó al tercero, el de la concentración total de poder en una empresa, como “terrible”.
El primer escenario, que Altman habría favorecido, consiste en la creación de un organismo internacional de supervisión inspirado en el Organismo Internacional de Energía Atómica (OIEA), el ente de las Naciones Unidas que vigila el uso de la energía nuclear. Ese cuerpo auditaría los sistemas de inteligencia artificial más potentes antes de su lanzamiento y controlaría el consumo global de capacidad de cómputo.
El plan que lleva el nombre de Demis Hassabis
El segundo escenario, apodado “plan Demis” en referencia al director ejecutivo de Google DeepMind, Demis Hassabis, propone fusionar a los principales laboratorios de inteligencia artificial en una sola organización, a la manera del CERN, el centro europeo de investigación nuclear que reúne a decenas de países. articles.title: It's official — new scientific report says your boss should talk less and listen more in meetings
articles.summary:
It's official — new scientific report says your boss should talk less and listen more in meetings
Yep, he's still talking
- New research claims meetings are considered successful when all participants experience a balance of speaking and listening
- Meetings are defined in the research as a gathering with a goal or structure
- Over three decades of meeting science has been reveiwed for the 2026 Annual Review of Organizational Psychology and Organizational Behavior
A new in-depth review of the science of meetings shows that listening trumps talking when getting together to discuss matters at work – and perhaps that bosses should talk less.
The 2026 Annual Review of Organizational Psychology and Organizational Behavior comprises over three decades of meeting science, a growing field among social psychologists. With a growing archive of meeting data available thanks to better written recording and online meeting calls, the review also found that meetings that are going nowhere should be abandoned.
Assembled by a team of researchers who all contributed, the review has uncovered some home truths for meeting leaders and bosses: that just because they think it went well doesn’t mean it actually did.
The meeting doom
Everyone has their experiences of meetings that seem to go nowhere, or endless meander around a point that has already been decided or discarded.

articles.title: Desde un mapa de ondas sísmicas hasta un juego en 3D: los usos más destacados de la IA Gemini 4 Argon
articles.summary:
Gemini 4 Argon, el nuevo modelo de inteligencia artificial de Google presentado como herramienta de vanguardia para proyectos complejos, ya muestra resultados concretos de la mano de desarrolladores que experimentan con sus capacidades. Desde su lanzamiento a gran escala la semana pasada, programadores de distintos países utilizaron el modelo para crear simulaciones 3D, videojuegos multijugador y visualizaciones de datos en tiempo real, cinco de las cuales la propia compañía destacó como ejemplos representativos de lo que Argon puede lograr.
El modelo se distingue por su capacidad de análisis profundo en tareas complejas del mundo real, con aplicaciones que abarcan la programación, las finanzas, el derecho, la ciberseguridad y la ciencia. Según Google, la precisión y la profundidad que Argon mantiene en procesos de múltiples pasos le permiten superar a otros modelos de vanguardia en pruebas comparativas realizadas en diferentes áreas.
Una simulación de hidroavión puso a prueba el razonamiento espacial del modelo
Entre las mejoras más relevantes de Gemini 4 Argon se encuentran el razonamiento espacial, la precisión matemática y la codificación visual, capacidades que le permiten generar entornos tridimensionales complejos. articles.title: Leaked LiteLLM Master Key Let Attackers Steal GitHub Tokens and Hijack Release Pipeline
articles.summary:
LiteLLM on Friday revealed that an Agent Platform master key accidentally published to a public GitHub repository in late May 2026 ultimately allowed the threat actor to push a malicious version of the popular Python package.
"On May 27, 2026, a configuration file was committed to the public LiteLLM-Labs/lite-harness repository which inadvertently contained the master key to a deployment of the LiteLLM Agent Platform, an open source tool we use for orchestrating agents," LiteLLM's Oliver Jensen and Mateo Wang said.
"The error was quickly identified, the commit force-pushed over, and we identified the exposed keys as requiring revocation. However, key revocation did not occur for the master key."
LiteLLM said the unknown attacker (operating from "69.48.229[.]143") used this unrevoked key on October 10, 2026, to gain access to the Agent Platform and extracted a GitHub CLI OAuth token the service was configured with to allow self-hosted cloud agents to file pull requests to GitHub repositories.
The token, per the developers of the open-source large language model (LLM) gateway, was "not scoped down" and associated with its GitHub organization owner's account.
Gaining access to the token allowed the attacker to possess owner-level access to all repositories across the organization and perform additional credential exfiltration. The sequence of actions performed by the threat actor following this step is as follows -

articles.title: Brotli Decoder Flaw Behind Node.js RCE Also Affects Bun, Python and Other Widely Used Software
articles.summary:
A memory-corruption flaw in Google's Brotli decoder sits in many programs that unpack Brotli-compressed data, among them Bun, the Python Brotli and brotlicffi packages, and Envoy proxies set up to decompress Brotli.
Tracked as CVE-2026-111497, the flaw allows crafted compressed data to overwrite past the end of a buffer and corrupt a program's memory, potentially causing a crash, a memory leak, or the execution of attacker-controlled code.
Imperva researchers have shown that code can run on one unpatched Node.js build. The same has not been demonstrated on the other software, and no real-world attacks have been reported.
The flaw was first disclosed on October 21, when Node.js and Google shipped fixes, and more have followed product by product since. Because the bug is in Google's decoder and each program ships its own copy of it, every one has to update that copy on its own.
Brotli is a compression format from Google, used across the web to shrink pages and other traffic. The bug is in the C code that unpacks a Brotli stream, so it travels into anything that reuses that code, from language runtimes to proxies to Python packages.

Una encuesta interna de Xbox Research plantea un escenario en el que la mayoría de los juegos de Xbox Game Studios quedarían limitados a sus propias plataformas, con una excepción importante: Call of Duty.
La información fue reportada por Windows Central y no representa un cambio confirmado por Microsoft. Sin embargo, la consulta permite conocer una de las alternativas que la compañía estaría considerando para el futuro de su división de videojuegos, ahora bajo el liderazgo de Asha Sharma.
La posible estrategia afectaría a franquicias como Halo, Gears of War, Fallout, The Elder Scrolls, DOOM, Diablo y Minecraft. También incluiría a PHYSINT, el próximo videojuego de espionaje del desarrollador japonés Hideo Kojima, cuya publicación está vinculada a Xbox.
Xbox podría limitar sus principales franquicias a sus consolas

articles.title: Pensilvania obligará a etiquetar los avisos publicitarios hechos o editados con inteligencia artificial
articles.summary:
El gobernador de Pensilvania, Josh Shapiro, firmó la Ley de Publicidad Engañosa con Inteligencia Artificial, que obliga a las empresas a avisar cuando un aviso publicitario fue creado o modificado de forma significativa con esta tecnología. La norma entrará en vigencia el 21 de diciembre de 2026.
La ley abarca a imágenes, videos, audios y textos generados o editados con inteligencia artificial que se muestren a consumidores del estado, sin importar dónde se haya producido el aviso. Pensilvania se convierte así en uno de los primeros estados de Estados Unidos en exigir este tipo de advertencia.
“Si ves un aviso en Facebook o en internet y fue generado con inteligencia artificial, tienen que poner una advertencia abajo que diga que fue generado con IA”, explicó el senador estatal Nick Pisciottano, autor del proyecto, a CBS News.
Qué dice la nueva ley
El texto de la ley exige que la advertencia se muestre la primera vez que el contenido sintético aparece ante el consumidor, en el mismo formato del aviso, y que sea permanente o muy difícil de eliminar cuando sea técnicamente posible.
La obligación alcanza tanto a comerciales televisivos de grandes empresas como a folletos de promociones de restaurantes locales, siempre que el contenido sintético pueda generar una percepción falsa sobre el origen o la autenticidad de lo que se vende.
La norma deja algunas excepciones: no aplica a contenido “evidentemente ficticio”, a parodias, sátiras, críticas o comentarios, ni a publicidad limit…

articles.title: Standard CPUs are too bloated for fast storage — SK Hynix has a solution
articles.summary:
Samsung's archrival wants to spread 100 special CPUs in every SSD controller ahead of PCIe 8.0, High Bandwidth Flash onslaught
New chip architecture packs 100 custom processors into SSDs
- SK Hynix plans to distribute more than 100 processors across SSD controllers
- H-TPUs reportedly consume just 2.5% of conventional CPU core power
- Each H-TPU occupies only 4% of a general-purpose processor core's area
SK Hynix is developing solid-state drive controllers with more than 100 compact processors to manage increasingly demanding data transfers.
The South Korean memory manufacturer says its Hynix Transaction Processing Unit (H-TPU) architecture reduces processor power requirements and chip area.
The technology is designed for enterprise storage products and future memory systems serving demanding artificial intelligence workloads.
Small processors take over repetitive SSD operations
Speaking at the recent International SoC Design Conference, SK Hynix vice president Koo In-je described limitations affecting conventional SSD controller designs.
"Currently, general-purpose CPUs inside SSD controllers are at their limits in terms of power consumption and area," he said.
"Instead, SK Hynix has developed an H-TPU that can efficiently handle common input/output (I/O) transmission paths."
Conventional processors handle routine operations alongside demanding tasks, including reading and writing data, updating metadata, and controlling buffers.
